in_sanskrit.name: Lovish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Friend, Love
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lovish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Loka' which means 'people' and 'Vish' which means 'friend'. This name signifies one who is loved by the people and is a friend to all.

in_hindi.name: लोविश
in_hindi.long_meaning: Premit (प्रेमित) - Fond of Love, Beloved, Dear.

in_marathi.name: Lovish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lovish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Loka' which means 'people' and 'Vish' which means 'friend'. This name signifies one who is loved by the people and is a friend to all.

in_bengali.name: Lovish
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Friend, Love
in_bengali.long_meaning: Lovish একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Loka' which means 'people' and 'Vish' which means 'friend'. This name signifies one who is loved by the people and is a friend to all.
